note: Independent, versioned assessment of the 71 HIGH defects of Gates 0B.1 to 0B.6 that carry no release disposition. Every proposed disposition is a preparer recommendation derived from the frozen defect record, the operation records that carry the defect and the source quotes they cite. None is an accepted determination, executed proof or a change to a frozen severity or hash. A defect whose frozen record under-evidences the question is REVIEW_REQUIRED.
separation: A proposed disposition is a release-disposition assessment. It is distinct from the defect, from a challenge, from an exposure contract, from an engineering repair obligation and from an accepted release decision.

rubric.RB_XT: It reaches or changes another organization data and no executed proof of containment is on file.
rubric.RB_MF: It discloses sensitive records to every authenticated member of the organization.
rubric.RB_FALSE: It returns or records a false outcome, attestation or success for work that did not happen or cannot be verified.
rubric.RB_CRED: It exposes or accepts credential or authentication state in a forgeable or client-visible form.
rubric.RB_SHARED: It lets a tenant role write or delete data that every organization reads.
rubric.RB_ANYMUT: It lets a caller below the owning authority change another person record or a protected field.
rubric.CB_AUD: The over-disclosure is confined to the organization at a restricted floor; whether it is acceptable depends on an institutional audience decision that is outstanding.
rubric.CB_PLAT: The floor is a platform role title over cross-organization data; it blocks unless the title is shown to be held only by platform staff under an adopted mandate.
rubric.CB_INERT: The route is inert or misnamed; it blocks release only while it is reachable or advertised as a working capability.
rubric.CB_DEP: The impact depends on a deployment or scheduler fact that the repository cannot establish.
rubric.CB_INT: The integrity defect is limited to role-restricted callers of the same organization; it blocks while those callers can reach the route.
rubric.RR: The frozen record does not carry enough evidence to place the defect; the missing evidence is named.
